# Hyperspectral_HYU developer rules

Only develop the requested track (싱글/멀티/연속); shared B17 physics in 공통/ must remain consistent. Original B17 hash validation mandatory. Full grids 3800/1429/512/3000; 440–660 nm; object and metasurface phase [0,2π); GD100 + L-BFGS100 and circular prior .015 for fixed single benchmark. Do not change geometry, data, objective or iteration budget silently. No truth/labels in inverse. Separate generation, recovery, evaluation. Never fabricate results or treat a plan/forward as recovery. Record exact command, hashes, metrics and status in docs. Keep old historical benchmark separate from new performance. Do not overwrite existing run outputs. No old failed code in active default path. Read docs/RESEARCH_PROGRESS.md and docs/REPRODUCTION.md before work.

## Single-track decision, 2026-11-13
Single is RBC-only. Default: 512² Full GD100 (zero start, no prior) -> Spectral Periodic tangent L-BFGS100 (alpha .015). No pyramid, no unwrapping, no reduced optics. General images belong to other tracks or historical comparisons. The periodic comparator and blind scan are experimental options, not defaults. Fixed historical benchmark: same 660 nm sensor, 49/50 groups, ROI .077085576 rad, group31 .329843217 rad. Full pyramid comparisons were worse; do not revive them without a specific experimental reason. Improve from the spectral baseline, prioritize overlapping RBC and group31 without truth-dependent optimization, verify independent scenes/seeds. Do not claim the integrated solver has reproduced 49/50 until measured. Do not silently alter the accepted step budgets or optical geometry.
